column1: # Per-module build times for the module report (ARCHITECTURE.md, "Modules over the monolith"), in the
# same shape scripts/lib/build-times.sh writes and scripts/module-report.mjs reads: kind, name, ms, note.
# HOW EACH ROW WAS MEASURED. One source file of the module was touched, then
# (rust/wa-capabilities/build.rs refuses to build without prepared code-mode assets). The note says how many
# compilation units the compiler actually built: ONE unit is the cost of a change IN that module on a warm
# dependency graph, and more units mean its dependency graph was cold, so that row is an upper bound and not
# WHAT THIS IS NOT. Not a gate - scripts/module-report.mjs only prints it - and not yet the whole tree: 4 of
# 76 modules are measured here. A second session was compiling into the same CARGO_TARGET_DIR while these
# ran, so the multi-unit rows are upper bounds twice over. A fast run fills the rest of the shape with its
# own numbers for whatever it compiles (`node scripts/module-report.mjs --timings <that ledger>`).

column4: 12 units, cold dependency graph (upper bound), WA_CODEMODE_ALLOW_EMPTY=1
